info.name: VAYRO Services 8, 9, 10, 12 (Route History, Transport Job, Alert & Geofence, Integration & Logging)
info.description: Import with local.postman_environment.json. Run 00 Setup first, then 09, 10, 08, 12. Local test database only; no real credentials are included.

item.name: 00 Setup

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.environment.set('access_token', d.access_token); pm.environment.set('refresh_token', d.refresh_token); pm.environment.set('company_id', d.user.company_id); }

request.description: The driver must be an active user with role driver in the same company as the Company Admin. driver_user_id is filled in from the login.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.environment.set('driver_access_token', d.access_token); pm.environment.set('driver_user_id', d.user.user_id); }

item.description: Log in first. Needs login_email / login_password (Company Admin), driver_email / driver_password, and vehicle_id of an ACTIVE vehicle of that company.

item.name: 10 Alert and Geofence

exec: pm.test('201, or 409 if the company already has one', () => pm.expect([201, 409]).to.include(pm.response.code));
pm.test('201, or 409 if the company already has one', () => pm.expect([201, 409]).to.include(pm.response.code));
const rule = pm.response.json().data.find(r => r.rule_type === 'overspeed'); if (rule) pm.environment.set('overspeed_rule_id', rule.alert_rule_id);

item.name: 10.04 Threshold out of range must fail

request.description: Alerts appear after: a job is assigned (job_assignment), a problem is reported (system_anomaly), or GPS points trigger a rule. Needs GPS_EVENT_SUBSCRIBERS in .env for the GPS ones.

exec: const rows = pm.response.json().data; if (rows.length) pm.environment.set('alert_id', rows[0].alert_id); else console.log('No alerts yet: run the job steps (09.10, 09.17) or send GPS points first.');
pm.test('Only alerts addressed to me', () => pm.response.json().data.every(a => a.recipient_user_id === pm.environment.get('driver_user_id')));
pm.test('200 (404 if there is no alert yet)', () => pm.expect([200, 404]).to.include(pm.response.code));
pm.test('200 (404 if there is no alert yet)', () => pm.expect([200, 404]).to.include(pm.response.code));
pm.test('200, 409 if already handled/resolved, 404 if none', () => pm.expect([200, 404, 409]).to.include(pm.response.code));
pm.test('409 (404 if there is no alert)', () => pm.expect([404, 409]).to.include(pm.response.code));

item.description: Rules, circular geofences and alerts. Overspeed, geofence and GPS-offline alerts also need GPS points flowing (see README).

item.name: 08 Route History

exec: pm.test('Has summary and points', () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.summary.point_count).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(d.points).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('Has distance and gaps', () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.distance_km).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(d.gaps).to.be.an('array'); });

item.name: 08.05 Range longer than 31 days must fail

item.description: Needs GPS points stored for vehicle_id (see ../postman/README.md, GPS section). Points are ordered by recorded_at.

item.name: 12 Integration and Logging

request.description: The key is saved in the environment variable external_api_key (secret). Do not export the environment with it filled in.

exec: pm.test('Key returned once, hash never', () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.api_key).to.match(/^vyr_[0-9a-f]{8}\./); pm.expect(d).to.not.have.property('api_key_hash'); });
pm.test('Never shows hash or full key', () => pm.expect(JSON.stringify(pm.response.json().data)).to.not.match(/api_key_hash|"api_key"/));

request.description: Empty until a gateway or service records external calls through POST /internal/request-logs.
Merges the audit rows of integration-service, transport-service and alert-service. meta.sources shows which of them answered. Other services' logs are not included yet.
